title: Search is on for suspect in two shootings on the Northwest Side, BCSO says - NewsBreak
text: The Bexar County Sheriff’s Office is asking for the public’s help in locating a man wanted in connection with two shootings that occurred minutes apart on July 22. Deputies first responded to a home on Pure Silver after shots were fired at a parked vehicle, striking its windshield. Before they arrived, a second shooting was reported at a nearby home on Silver Hollow, damaging a vehicle, garage door, and front door, BCSO said in a Facebook post. Investigators say both victims had argued with the alleged suspect, later identified as Kevin Balditt, earlier that day in a group text where threats were allegedly made. Surveillance video showed a brown GMC Sierra at both locations. ALSO READ: Man shot dead after argument in South Side ditch escalates, say San Antonio police The next day, July 23, deputies executed search warrants at a Lateleaf Oak residence, seizing two handguns, matching shell casings, surveillance video, and the suspect’s phone. Surveillance footage captured Balditt at both crime scenes, BCSO said. While Balditt admitted to driving during both incidents, he told investigators that another person fired the shots. However, Balditt is on the run as of today, according to BCSO. Balditt faces four counts of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon and one count of deadly conduct. Anyone with information on his whereabouts is urged to call the Bexar County Sheriff’s Office at 210-335-6000 or email BCSOTIPS@bexar.org . Tipsters can remain anonymous.
